blocks.text: The amendments to the IEBC adopted herein shall be set out in this chapter. All references to section and chapter numbers shall be construed as if followed by the words “of the International Existing Building Code,” unless clearly indicated otherwise. (Ord. 20344 § 3, 2-15-22.)
